clues.q: The eldest Pevensie, who becomes High King.
Father Christmas gives Lucy a dagger and a little diamond bottle of this healing drink.
The Professor's strict housekeeper, who shows visitors around the house.
The Pevensies are sent to the Professor's house to get away from these attacks on London.
Susan's royal title is Susan the this.
Bree, who carries Shasta north to Narnia, is this kind of animal.
Reepicheep is the chief of these small animals.
The gentle donkey who gets dressed up in a lion skin.
Shift, the sneaky troublemaker in The Last Battle, is this kind of animal.
The loyal badger who helps Caspian and never stops believing in Old Narnia.
The red dwarf the Pevensies rescue from two soldiers in Prince Caspian.
The bitter black dwarf who wants to call back the White Witch.
Aslan breathes on this giant, who then smashes open the Witch's castle gates.
Huge letters carved into the ruined city of the giants spell out these two words.
The one dwarf who stays loyal and fights beside Tirian in The Last Battle.
The hot southern country where Shasta grew up.
The dying world under a red sun where Digory wakes the Witch.
Near the end of the world, the surface of the sea is covered in these white flowers.
The wild moors north of Narnia where Jill, Eustace and Puddleglum meet stone-throwing giants.
The castle and capital of Archenland that Rabadash attacks.
The White Witch uses this to turn creatures to stone.
Caspian blows this magic gift of Father Christmas to call for help.
Every night, Prince Rilian is tied to this.
In the dragon's treasure, Eustace finds a gold bracelet that belonged to this lost lord.
The name of Peter's sword.
The young king who sails east on the Dawn Treader.
King Lune's son, who turns out to be Shasta's twin.
The cab driver's wife, who becomes Narnia's very first queen.
Caspian marries the daughter of this star.
The last king of Narnia.

categories.name: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe

clues.q: The Witch's spell keeps Narnia stuck in this season for a hundred years.
The wolf who leads the Witch's secret police, until Peter kills him.
Aslan brings the statues in the Witch's courtyard back to life by doing this.
The Stone Table cracks and Aslan comes back to life at this time of day.
The Witch claims Edmund because every traitor belongs to her as her lawful this.
Lucy sees him first, but the others don't believe her.
Caspian's life is suddenly in danger when Miraz's wife has one of these.
Peter challenges Miraz to this to settle the war.
The two Telmarine lords who betray Miraz.
Aslan reveals that the Telmarines are descended from these people from our world.

categories.name: The Voyage of the Dawn Treader

clues.q: In the magician's book, Lucy is tempted by a spell to make herself this.
Aslan turns Eustace back into a boy by doing this to his dragon skin.
The Dawn Treader's front is carved in the shape of this creature's head.
Near the end of the world, they find the seawater has become this.
The old man on Ramandu's island is a retired one of these.
Uncle Andrew tricks Polly into touching one of these, and she vanishes.
In the hall of statues, Digory strikes this and wakes the Witch.
The Witch tears off part of one of these London objects to use as a weapon. It later grows in Narnia.
Digory flies to the garden in the west on this winged horse.
The cab horse's name before Aslan gives him wings.
The cruel god the Calormenes worship.
Shift dresses Puzzle in the skin of this animal.
Tirian's best friend, a unicorn.
The building whose door leads into Aslan's Country.
The young Calormene who served Tash but is welcomed by Aslan.
I'm a lion, and I'm Narnia's true king.
I'm Lucy's brother. I betrayed everyone for sweets, then became a king.
I'm a Marsh-wiggle who always expects the worst.
I'm a boy who turned into a dragon.
I'm the girl who goes to Narnia with Eustace from Experiment House.

final.clue: The boy who plants the apple core from Narnia grows up to own the house with the wardrobe.
